crossRefs.note: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all…
Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, Yahweh.
Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn; for his loving kindness endures forever;
For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath…
and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory,
See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue…
They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works…
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation…
I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of…
My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

translations.web: I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.
translations.bsb: I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.
translations.kjv: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
translations.asv: I will sing of lovingkindness and justice: Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I sing praises.
